observations.observation: Persistent navigation separates entry, agent destinations and footer actions; agent entries have tooltips.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use authorized QuantOS domain routes; no agent-driven authority.

observations.observation: A side sheet lists prior conversations with timestamps and per-item actions.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use immutable research history; do not import upstream conversation schema or deletion semantics.

observations.observation: A search dialog filters stock entries, separates empty/loading states and displays per-item watchlist action feedback.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use licensed snapshot-backed discovery and explicit stale/permission states; no upstream market adapter.

observations.observation: A scrollable watchlist organizes selected instruments into repeatable list items.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use QuantOS DataGrid and controlled selection; filters persist in URL.

observations.observation: Two-column task cards associate agent identity and time with result links.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use ResearchArtifact/evidence cards; this is not evidence of a committee or counter-view implementation.

observations.observation: A context header combines identity tags with new-conversation and configuration navigation.
observations.quantosConstraint: Expose only authorized research actions and version metadata; no upstream settings/accounts.

observations.observation: A multiline input composes text and sends through keyboard/button handlers.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use bounded ResearchComposer with snapshot, budget and deadline checks; text never authorizes trading.

observations.observation: Conversation items dispatch to typed renderers and retain an unsupported-content fallback.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use allowlisted, redacted QuantOS artifact previews; arbitrary renderer content cannot execute tools.

observations.observation: A separate report section presents a title, return action and rendered report body.
observations.quantosConstraint: Preserve resource authorization and return context; report text is not verified evidence by itself.

observations.observation: A streaming indicator exposes an output region with visible activity feedback.
observations.quantosConstraint: Use authoritative run state and server-confirmed cancellation; activity is not success.

observations.observation: The initial empty conversation screen makes the input action immediately available.
observations.quantosConstraint: Offer only permitted research next steps with reason; no trading prompt or permission bypass.

observations.observation: A nested conversation card combines context, running feedback and a detail link.
observations.quantosConstraint: Keep intermediate/final distinction and native evidence links; no notification or approval authority.

limitation: Static source structure, not shipped/runtime/browser/usability verification. Existing source grades are conservative design-inspiration grades; this supplement does not reclassify roadmap or QuantOS extensions as delivered upstream features.
